claims: lean/Sqpack/RyuLayers.lean (first committed at 4b456fe, 2026-10-18T05:44:46Z; unchanged at the pin) states theorem UnitSquarePacking.Ryu.packs_sub_4sqrt2_layers (k : ℕ) (hk : 7 ≤ k) : ∃ s < (k : ℝ), Packs (k * k - 4 * (Nat.sqrt (2 * k - 8) + 1)) s, that is k^2 - 4b unit squares in a square of side less than k with b = ceil(sqrt(2k - 7)) = Nat.sqrt (2k - 8) + 1, so c*(k) <= 4 ceil(sqrt(2k - 7)) - 1 for every k >= 7; and packs_layers (k b : ℕ) (hb : 3 ≤ b) (hkb : b + 4 ≤ k) (hk : 2 * k ≤ b ^ 2 + 7) : ∃ s < (k : ℝ), Packs (k * k - 4 * b) s.

The construction: Ryu's L-shaped packing with b = ceil(sqrt(2k - 7)), L - 3 rows per band of length L, and floor((b - 1)/2), floor((b - 1)/2), floor(b/2) and floor(b/2) + 1 + 1 axis squares in the four band ends, 2b in all (RyuEnds.band_ends: Ryu's Lemma 5.1 in general form, the rotation by pi, half-plane separation and axis layers); the angle t = 1/b + delta with delta * b D (6k + 4b) = 1, D = b^2 + 1. The commit message and certificates/k2-minus-c/README.md say standard axioms only (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound) and that for 7 <= k <= 3*10^5 no other b or axis layering of this construction does better (search/ryu/r1prime.py).
lean/Sqpack/RyuFill.lean (a645fe3, 2026-10-18T02:28:04Z) states packs_sub_4sqrt2: c*(k) <= 4 ceil(sqrt(2k - 7)) + 5 for every k >= 7, one axis layer of floor(b/2) - 1 squares at each band end.
